trigger.scope: P0 decomposition of current business processes

rationale: Extract citation safety from bp_refs_and_submission into a focused refs BP. It keeps actor/ownership citation branching, public-record sweep, topic-doc routing, and discovery answer/ref parity while delegating terminal submission and fraud search to separate units.

dependencies.why: Authority for cross-boundary and personal-information citation boundaries.
Actor shape used by customer/employee/guest citation branches.
Basket ownership, status, store pointer, and canonical path shape refs decisions.
Payment ownership, basket/store pointers, status, and canonical path shape refs decisions.
Return ownership, basket/payment pointers, status, and canonical path shape refs decisions.
Customer profile/contact fields determine private citation boundaries.
Employee roster/contact/store fields determine employee private vs operational refs.
Public store path and location fields are required public-record refs.
Public catalogue path and SKU fields are required public-record refs.

rollback.strategy: Remove this unit from registry and restore bp_refs_and_submission if split citation routing drops required refs or over-cites private records.
